required_input_state.restoration_rule: Restore exact requested identities and actions, including responsive-binding scope/effects/exclusions and approval gate references when present. Recheck current availability, freshness, completeness, compatibility, source rights, permission, approval validity, and satisfaction before repeating a request or resuming the controlled action.

test_evidence_state.restoration_rule: Restore evidence references, reproducibility state, regulatory obligations, and presentation preference as separate state. Presentation mode never proves evidence exists and never changes evidence obligations. Revalidate referenced suites, manifests, results, logs, fixtures, sanitization state, current inputs/environment/permissions, and exact run identities. Missing records remain missing; do not fabricate them from a smaller prior display.

grounding_state.restoration_rule: Revalidate exact component and manifest identities, dependency compatibility, task fit, approval state, and current Orbit 0 compilation before treating Grounding support as operative.

ai_governance_state.restoration_rule: Revalidate exact package and component identities, current source authority and freshness, source rights, jurisdiction, organizational role, lifecycle, intended purpose, regulatory evidence obligations, framework-adapter availability, task fit, approval state, and Orbit 0 compilation. Do not treat prior analysis or validation as legal advice, compliance proof, certification, conformity, deployment approval, or current-source verification.

continuation_bootstrap.material_execution_resume_condition: A current HANDOFF_RESTORE alignment evaluation succeeds and exactly one validated artifact is rebound to Orbit 0 with ACTIVE_EXECUTION_BINDING.
continuation_bootstrap.missing_active_candidate_behavior: Compile a new candidate from restored project state and current user direction.
continuation_bootstrap.user_task_change_behavior: Treat selection as bootstrap input; promote selected task and queue the prior nomination if still valid.
continuation_bootstrap.required_input_recheck: Before repeating a request or resuming its controlled action, recheck session availability, validated package state, freshness, completeness, compatibility, source rights, permission, and satisfaction. Preserve exact identities and do not infer satisfaction from attachment alone.
continuation_bootstrap.test_evidence_recheck: Restore test_evidence_state without treating the card or presentation mode as proof that tests ran or evidence is sufficient. Revalidate every referenced suite, manifest, result, log, fixture, sanitization state, reproducibility claim, and regulatory obligation. If requested evidence was never captured, preserve the gap and require a new authorized run when that evidence is material.
continuation_bootstrap.method_handoff_recheck: When method continuation is material, validate method identity/version/origin, active method state/step/gate, staleness, evidence references, blockers, next action, and method_specific_state against the current method requirements before artifact rebinding. Missing material state routes to REVIEW; do not invent it.
continuation_bootstrap.responsive_binding_recheck: Restore responsive-binding requests and approval evidence only as continuation input. Revalidate the exact approval gate, disclosed scope/effects, component identity, freshness, compatibility, selection, and artifact compilation before binding. Attachment history alone is not approval.
continuation_bootstrap.specialist_catalog_recheck: When specialist catalog provenance is recorded, compare the originating AIR_SPECIALIST_PACKAGE_INDEX identity with any currently supplied validated index before using the current index for new discovery. Exact same-release catalog identity permits normal discovery after explicit handoff Specialist/package state is restored and revalidated. A missing index degrades discovery without invalidating otherwise valid explicit handoff state. A different or foundation-incompatible index is a new-environment discovery input and requires targeted compatibility reconciliation before new catalog discovery. Never substitute, select, approve, bind, or rewrite restored Specialist state from index metadata alone.
continuation_bootstrap.runtime_alignment_recheck: Historical alignment evaluation identities and results are provenance only. Execute a new Core RT.ALIGN evaluation using HANDOFF_RESTORE profile against current-session state before any restored state becomes execution-bearing.
continuation_bootstrap.semantic_fidelity_recheck: Restore only explicit canonical-intent/context references and unresolved semantic ambiguities, then reconcile them against available raw input/source evidence and current user direction. Do not silently reinterpret missing intent.
continuation_bootstrap.mii_recheck: Restore MII contribution references, conflict state, and morphology state as non-authorizing continuation input. Revalidate contribution availability/task fit and compile applicable validated contributions into or explicitly reference them from the rebound Orbit 0 AIR_ARTIFACT benchmark before operative use.
continuation_bootstrap.route_map_recheck: AIR_RUNTIME_ROUTE_MAP.json is discovery/salience metadata only. If supplied, validate identity and Core compatibility; if missing or stale, Core route semantics remain authoritative and runtime continues without granting the map semantic authority.

rules.v2_2_pre_rev12_specialist_catalog_state: NO_SCHEMA_MIGRATION_REQUIRED; rev11 or earlier schema-2.2.0 cards may omit specialist catalog provenance. Treat originating catalog identity as UNRECORDED_PRE_REV12, restore all other explicit state normally, and use any currently supplied compatible index only for new discovery after restoration/revalidation. Never claim it was the originating catalog.
rules.v2_2_to_v2_3_alignment: MIGRATE runtime_watchdog_state/cadence carriers as historical provenance only. Preserve post_activation_user_message_count only as diagnostic/anchor state. Do not restore alignment intervals, periodic-due state, or historical PASS as current authority. Execute a new HANDOFF_RESTORE alignment evaluation.
rules.v2_2_to_v2_3_evidence_presentation: Map legacy SUMMARY_ONLY display intent to STANDARD_EVIDENCE_PRESENTATION and legacy FULL_TEST_EVIDENCE display intent to EXPANDED_EVIDENCE_PRESENTATION only. Do not infer evidence capture or reproducibility from the old display mode.
rules.v2_2_to_v2_3_mii: Missing MII, semantic-fidelity, morphology, or epistemic-sufficiency carriers are valid legacy absence, not inferred completed state. Reconstruct only from explicit supported source/artifact state and current evaluation; otherwise preserve UNRESOLVED or request required input.

schema_compatibility_contract.schema_2_2_migration_rule: Accept as migration input only; normalize cadence/evidence display semantics and require current alignment plus artifact rebinding before execution.

rules: The catalog does not restore, select, approve, compile, bind, or substitute a Specialist by itself.
Exact originating-catalog identity may be established only from recorded designation, version, hash, and foundation compatibility identity.

If the originating index was available and its exact bytes were carried or referenced, file_identity_and_delivery_state.file_receipts should preserve its canonical filename, designation, version, hash, bytes, and delivery state.
A missing current index degrades only catalog discovery; it does not invalidate otherwise valid explicit Specialist/package handoff state.
A different current index preserves restored Specialist/package state and requires targeted catalog compatibility reconciliation before new discovery.
A foundation-incompatible current index is treated as a new-environment discovery input and cannot be represented as exact continuation.
For pre-rev12 cards with no catalog provenance, originating catalog identity is UNRECORDED_PRE_REV12 rather than inferred from the currently supplied index.
Migration to schema 2.3.0 does not grant the Specialist Package Index route, selection, approval, compilation, binding, or execution authority.

transfer_ownership_contract.purpose: Define one canonical transfer carrier for current transfer-level state while preserving source-object snapshots as non-executable provenance.
rules: AIR_HANDOFF_CARD is a transfer record and may serialize source-object snapshots; snapshots never become current execution authority on restore.

When the same conceptual datum appears in a source-object snapshot and a transfer-level carrier, the source snapshot preserves provenance while the transfer-level carrier named below governs transfer interpretation.
A repeated value without a distinct source-snapshot role or explicit reference is invalid redundant transfer state.

Historical alignment evaluations, action authorizations, gates, receipts, and artifact bindings restore only as provenance/history unless the current runtime separately revalidates and reissues the required current object.

source_snapshot_roles.AIR_HANDOFF_CARD.active_artifact: IMMUTABLE_PROVENANCE_SNAPSHOT_OF_SOURCE_ARTIFACT; prior binding/action/delivery values cannot override transfer-level carriers or restore execution authority.
source_snapshot_roles.AIR_HANDOFF_CARD.active_contract: IMMUTABLE_PROVENANCE_SNAPSHOT_OF_CONTRACT_INPUT; cannot override the Artifact or create execution authority.

transfer_ownership_contract.restore_rule: Resolve transfer-level carriers first, preserve source snapshots as provenance, then execute current-session validation/alignment and artifact rebinding. Never select a newer duplicate by convenience.

action_governance_state.authorization_restoration_rule: No AIR_ACTION_AUTHORIZATION survives handoff as executable authority. Preserve history and requested action context, then issue a new authorization only after restore validation and artifact rebinding.
action_governance_state.material_action_resume_rule: Revalidate artifact, lease, scope pin, sources, environment, permissions, approvals, pending receipts, and prior effects before issuing a new action authorization.

runtime_drift_hardening_schema_extension.restore_boundary: Historical alignment evaluation and action authorizations never restore as current executable authority. Restore explicit provenance/state only; current validation, alignment evaluation, dependency closure, and artifact rebinding remain required.

runtime_alignment_state.restoration_rule: Historical alignment evaluation is provenance only and must not be restored as current authority. Execute HANDOFF_RESTORE evaluation in the new session before state-sensitive construction, material action, or governed continuation.

semantic_fidelity_state.restoration_rule: Restore explicit references only; raw input remains source evidence. Revalidate intent/context fidelity before the rebound artifact is treated as executable.

mii_state.restoration_rule: MII state is continuation input only. Cognitive contributions have no positive execution authority and become operative only after validation and compilation into or explicit reference by the bound Orbit 0 AIR_ARTIFACT benchmark.

morphology_state.restoration_rule: Re-evaluate task and node morphology against current task intent, MII route objectives, benchmark, risk/evidence pressure, and Core RT.MORPHOLOGY_BIND. Prior Q4/Q4D state is a continuity/delivery prior only.

epistemic_sufficiency_state.restoration_rule: Material uncertainty remains unresolved until Core RT.UNCERTAINTY_RESOLVE obtains or validates the smallest sufficient input. Do not silently infer missing basis from handoff proximity or prior momentum.
